title: .npmrc: cafile, certfile and keyfile path settings
summary: A synthetic .npmrc with registry-scoped cafile, certfile and keyfile settings whose values are file paths.
rationale: keyfile and certfile sit in the same list as _authToken and are scoped the same way, so they look like credentials; npm documents them as paths to files. A path names where the key lives and contains none.

expectation.rationale: Not flagged. The npm documentation lists cafile as the path to a certificate authority file, certfile as the path to a certificate file and keyfile as the path to a key file. The value is a path, not the content of the file.

sources.supports: cafile (path to certificate authority file), certfile (path to certificate file), keyfile (path to key file).
